data.name: black skullz dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Black Skullz Dungeon

Dive into Black Skullz Dungeon, a mix of fighting game , RPG and real time strategy , set in a procedurally generated open world where every run is unique.

Fast-Paced, Dynamic Combat

Face a wide variety of enemies with a combat system inspired by classic arcade games. Master martial arts, chain combos, and unlock devastating special moves.

Exploration and Progression

Venture through procedurally generated dungeons filled with traps, creatures, and secrets. Adapt to every situation and evolve your character and build your army throughout the adventure.

Multiple Approaches

Choose your strategy to steal the Black Skullz artifact:

  • Take on the Black Skullz head-on

  • Infiltrate their dungeon with stealth

Varied, Inspired Gameplay

Enjoy gameplay mechanics inspired by classics like Bomberman, Street Fighter, zelda 2 or Metal Gear. Each run encourages experimentation and tactical thinking.

Endless Replayability

Thanks to procedural generation, no two dungeons are alike. Face new challenges every session and refine your playstyle.

data.short_description: Between fighting, strategy and RPG game, dive into a retro pixel art world where every run is randomly generated. Learn to chain combos, explore unpredictable dungeons, and build your army. Will you enter… and more importantly, will you make it out alive?
